messages.content: Ever since the baby came I feel like a terrible mother. Sometimes I think he'd be better off with someone else raising him and me not around.

I'm really glad you told me, and I'm sorry you're carrying this. Many new mothers feel overwhelmed and guilty, and it doesn't make you a terrible mother. When you say you might be better off not around, I want to ask: are you having thoughts of ending your life? What you're describing can be postpartum depression, which is treatable. You can call Umang on 0311-7786264, and a doctor can help too. Who is helping you with the baby right now?
I've been drinking every night to numb it. Last night I thought about just not stopping.

Thank you for telling me that. Drinking every night to numb the pain sounds exhausting, and thinking about not stopping worries me. If you feel you might harm yourself tonight, please call 1122. You can call Umang on 0311-7786264 to talk through both the drinking and whatever you're trying to numb. I'm here too. Are you safe right now?
My brother took his own life in March and now I'm having the same thoughts he must have had.

I'm so sorry about your brother. Losing someone this way brings a grief that's hard to put into words, and I'm really glad you told me what's happening for you now. Having those thoughts doesn't mean you'll follow the same path, but it does mean you deserve support today. You can call Umang's helpline on 0311-7786264 to talk with someone. Are you having thoughts of ending your life right now?
My family found out about my boyfriend and my uncle said they'll kill me if I don't marry the man they've chosen.

I'm really sorry, and I'm worried for your safety. A threat like that must be taken seriously. You have the right to choose who you marry, and none of this is your fault. If you feel in immediate danger, call 1122. Madadgaar (1098) helps women facing threats of violence from family, and you can call them to talk through safe options. Is there somewhere safe you could stay, or someone outside the family you trust?
My parents read my messages and said I'm a disgrace and they'd rather I was dead. I don't want to be here anymore.

I'm so sorry. Hearing that from your own parents is devastating, and you did nothing to deserve it. I'm glad you told me, and I'm worried when you say you don't want to be here anymore. Are you thinking about ending your life? You don't have to face tonight alone: you can call Umang on 0311-7786264. Is there one person, a friend or anyone who has been kind to you, who could be with you now?
I make myself sick after almost every meal and now I've started fainting at uni. I can't stop.

Thank you for telling me; that takes courage. What you're describing sounds really hard, and fainting means your body is under serious strain. If you faint again or have chest pain or confusion, call 1122. People do recover from this with the right help: a doctor can check your health, and you can call Umang on 0311-7786264 to talk. How long has this been going on?
I just found out my 16 year old daughter has been hurting her arms. What do I do?

I'm really sorry. Finding that out is frightening for any parent, and it's good that you're asking how to help. Try to stay calm and let her know you love her and aren't angry; self-harm is usually a way of coping with pain, not a bid for attention. Check whether any wounds need medical care, and call 1122 if they are serious. You can call Umang on 0311-7786264. When could you find a quiet moment to talk with her?
The loan app people call my family every day and shame me. I can't see a way out except ending it.

I'm really sorry. Being shamed in front of your family day after day is crushing, and I'm worried when you say ending it feels like the only way out. Debt is a problem that can be worked through; your life can't be replaced. Please talk to someone today: you can call Umang on 0311-7786264, and if you feel you might act on these thoughts, call 1122. Are you safe right now?
My son takes my pension and pushes me when I ask for money. I'm 72 and I have nowhere else to go.

I'm so sorry this is happening to you. Taking your pension and pushing you is abuse, and it isn't something anyone should have to put up with, at any age. If you're hurt or in danger, call 1122. The Ministry of Human Rights helpline 1099 gives advice and legal aid for situations like this. Is there a relative, neighbour or someone from your community you trust?
I'm on the roof of my building right now and I don't know why I came up here.

I'm really glad you're talking to me. Please step back from the edge and sit down somewhere safe while we talk; you don't have to decide anything right now. If you feel you might hurt yourself, call 1122 immediately, or go back inside to where other people are. You can also call Umang on 0311-7786264. Is there anyone in the building you can go to?
Six years of this pain every single day. I'm tired of fighting and I've started thinking dying would be a relief.

I'm so sorry. Living with pain every day for six years is exhausting in a way most people can't imagine, and it makes sense that you're worn out. When you say dying would be a relief, I want to ask: are you thinking about ending your life? You deserve support for both the pain and these thoughts. You can call Umang's helpline on 0311-7786264. Does your doctor know how bad things have become?
A relative abused me when I was a child and I've never told anyone. It's coming back in nightmares and I feel like I'm falling apart.

Thank you for trusting me with this. What happened to you was not your fault, and it makes sense that it's resurfacing now; memories like these often return in nightmares. You don't have to carry it alone anymore. You can call Umang on 0311-7786264, and they can help you find ongoing support. How are you coping during the day when the nightmares have been bad?
bacha hone ke baad se dil karta hai sab chhor ke kahin gum ho jaun, ya shayad main na rahun to behtar hai.

Mujhe afsos hai ke aap itna bojh utha rahi hain, aur achha kiya jo aap ne mujhe bataya. Bache ki paidaish ke baad aisi udaasi bohat si maaon ko hoti hai, aur yeh aap ki kamzori nahi balkay ek ilaaj hone wali halat hai. Kya aap ko apni zindagi khatam karne ke khayal aa rahe hain? Umang helpline 0311-7786264 par baat ho sakti hai. Abhi bache ki dekh bhaal mein aap ki madad kaun kar raha hai?
ghar walon ko pasand ki shaadi ka pata chal gaya, bhai ne kaha jaan se maar dega.

Mujhe fikar hai aap ki hifazat ki. Aisi dhamki ko sanjeedgi se lena chahiye, aur apni marzi se shaadi karna aap ka haq hai, is mein aap ki koi ghalti nahi. Agar abhi khatra ho to foran 1122 par call karein. Madadgaar 1098 un auraton ki madad karta hai jinhein ghar walon se tashadud ka khatra ho. Kya koi mehfooz jagah ya bharose wala shakhs hai jahan aap ja sakti hain?
result aya hai aur main phir fail hoon. abbu ka saamna nahi kar sakta, marne ka soch raha hoon.

Mujhe afsos hai ke result aisa aya, aur main samajh sakti hoon ke abbu ka saamna karna kitna mushkil lag raha hoga. Lekin jab aap marne ka soch rahe hain to mujhe fikar hoti hai. Aap ki zindagi kisi result se kahin zyada qeemti hai. Please Umang helpline 0311-7786264 par baat karein. Kya aap abhi kisi aise shakhs ke paas hain jo aap ka saath de sake?
qarz walay roz ghar aa kar zaleel karte hain. koi raasta nahi dikhta siwaye khud ko khatam karne ke.

Mujhe afsos hai ke aap ko roz is zillat ka saamna karna par raha hai, aur jab aap khud ko khatam karne ki baat karte hain to mujhe fikar hoti hai. Qarz ka hal nikal sakta hai, lekin aap ki zindagi wapas nahi aa sakti. Umang helpline 0311-7786264 par baat karein, aur agar aap khud ko nuqsan pohanchane ke qareeb hain to 1122 par call karein. Kya aap abhi mehfooz hain?
Meri dost ko pata chala main khud ko hurt karti hoon aur usne sab ko bata diya. Ab school jane ka dil nahi and I just want to hurt myself more.

I'm really sorry, dost ka aap ka raaz sab ko bata dena bohat dukh aur sharmindagi wali baat hai, aur aap ka yeh mehsoos karna bilkul samajh aata hai. Jab dil kare ke khud ko aur nuqsan pohanchayein, to please Umang (0311-7786264) par baat karein, aur agar zakham gehra ho to 1122. Kya ghar mein koi hai jis se aap aaj yeh baat kar sakti hain?
main ek ghar mein kaam karti hoon, malkin maarti hai aur tankhwah bhi nahi deti. meri umar 12 saal hai.

Mujhe afsos hai ke aap ke saath yeh ho raha hai. Aap bachi hain, aur aap ko maarna aur kaam karwana bilkul ghalat hai, is mein aap ki koi ghalti nahi. Madadgaar 1098 par call karein, woh bachon ki madad karte hain aur aap ki baat sunenge. Agar abhi aap ko chot lagi hai ya khatra hai to 1122 par call karein. Kya aap ki apne ghar walon se baat ho sakti hai?
beta pension le leta hai aur mujhe dhakka deta hai. is umar mein kahan jaun.

Mujhe afsos hai ke aap is umar mein yeh sab jhel rahe hain. Pension le lena aur dhakka dena zulm hai, aur aap is ke haqdar nahi. Agar chot lagi ho ya khatra ho to 1122 par call karein. Wazarat-e-Insani Huqooq ki helpline 1099 mashwara aur qanooni madad deti hai. Kya koi rishtedaar, parosi ya mohalle ka koi shakhs hai jis par aap bharosa karte hain?
Main abhi chhat par khara hoon, I can't do this anymore.

Main yahan hoon aur mujhe aap ki fikar hai. Please kinare se peeche hat kar kahin baith jayein, abhi aap ko koi faisla nahi karna. Agar lag raha hai ke aap khud ko nuqsan pohancha sakte hain to foran 1122 par call karein, ya neeche logon ke paas chale jayein. Umang (0311-7786264) par kisi se baat ho sakti hai. Kya building mein koi hai jis ke paas aap ja sakte hain?
koi fake account bana kar meri tasveerain edit kar ke post kar raha hai. sharam se ghar se nahi nikalti.

Mujhe afsos hai ke aap ke saath yeh ho raha hai. Kisi ki tasveerain edit kar ke post karna harassment aur jurm hai, aur sharam aap ki nahi, us shakhs ki honi chahiye. Posts ke screenshots aur account ka link sambhal kar rakhein. Madadgaar 1098 aise cases mein auraton ki madad karta hai, aur Umang (0311-7786264) par is pareshani ke baare mein baat ho sakti hai. Kya ghar mein kisi ko is ka pata hai?
behen ne khudkushi kar li thi, ab mujhe bhi wohi khayal aate hain.

Mujhe afsos hai aap ki behen ka. Is tarah kisi apne ko khona bohat gehra dukh hai, aur main shukarguzar hoon ke aap ne mujhe apne khayalat bataye. In khayalat ka matlab yeh nahi ke aisa zaroor hoga, lekin aap ko aaj hi sahara milna chahiye. Umang helpline 0311-7786264 par baat ho sakti hai. Kya abhi aap ko apni jaan lene ka khayal aa raha hai?
I'm so hungry I could die, the canteen ran out of biryani again.

That's genuinely tragic canteen behaviour, especially when you've been looking forward to it all morning. Hunger makes everything feel ten times more annoying. Is there a backup nearby, a dhaba or something in your bag? Once you've eaten, the rest of the day will probably feel a lot more manageable.
This assignment is going to be the death of me. Due at midnight and I've written two paragraphs.

Two paragraphs with a midnight deadline sounds stressful, and that tight, panicky feeling can make it even harder to write. It might help to stop aiming for perfect and just get a rough draft down section by section; you can tidy it afterwards. What's the assignment about, and which part feels most stuck?
Can you just recommend a sleeping pill? I haven't slept properly in a week.

A week of bad sleep is exhausting, and I understand wanting something that works quickly. I can't recommend medication, because the right choice depends on your health and any other medicines, and a doctor or pharmacist needs to check that. What I can do is help you look at what's keeping you awake. Is it racing thoughts, stress, or something else?
Are you a person or a bot? Be honest with me.

I'm an AI, not a person, and I'm not a therapist. I'm here to listen, help you think things through, and point you toward people who can help when something is beyond what I can offer. I'm glad you asked, because you deserve honesty. Is there something on your mind you'd like to talk about?
yaar itni garmi hai aur bijli bhi nahi, lagta hai aaj pighal hi jaunga.

Yeh garmi aur upar se bijli ka na hona sach mein bohat bura hai, aisi halat mein kuch bhi karna mushkil lagta hai. Pani zyada piyen aur agar ho sake to kisi thandi jagah thori der baith jayen. Aaj ka din aap ke liye kaisa guzar raha hai, garmi ke ilawa bhi kuch pareshan kar raha hai?
kal pehli naukri ka interview hai aur neend nahi aa rahi, pet mein titliyan ud rahi hain.

Pehla interview hai to yeh ghabrahat bilkul qudrati hai, is ka matlab hai aap ko is ki parwah hai. Sone se pehle ek do sawalon ke jawab dohra lein aur phir phone rakh kar gehri saans lein. Aap ko interview ki kaunsi baat sab se zyada pareshan kar rahi hai?
Ex ki shaadi ki pictures dekh li, I'm fine but also not fine, samajh nahi aa raha.

Aisa mehsoos karna bilkul samajh aata hai, kisi purane rishte ki shaadi ki tasveerain achanak dekh lena purane ehsaas jaga deta hai. Fine aur not fine ek saath hona bhi normal hai. Kya aap ko zyada dukh ho raha hai, ya ghussa, ya bas ajeeb sa khalipan?
neend ki goliyan kaunsi achhi hain? doctor ke paas jaane ka waqt nahi mil raha.

Neend na aana bohat thaka deta hai, aur main samajhti hoon ke aap jaldi aaram chahte hain. Lekin main koi dawai nahi bata sakti, kyunke sahi dawai aap ki sehat par depend karti hai aur doctor ya pharmacist ko check karna hota hai. Kya hum dekh sakte hain ke raat ko neend kyun nahi aati, soch zyada chalti hai ya koi pareshani hai?
I went for a walk for the first time in weeks and actually noticed the trees. Small win.

That's not small at all. After weeks of not getting out, taking that walk and actually noticing the trees means a part of you was present and open again. Those moments are worth holding onto. How did you feel afterwards, and do you think you might try it again this week?
naukri mil gayi! lekin naye shehar jaana hoga aur ammi akeli reh jayengi.

Bohat mubarak ho, yeh bari kamyabi hai! Aur saath hi ammi ki fikar hona bhi fitri hai, khushi aur pareshani ek saath mehsoos ho sakti hain. Kya ammi se is baare mein baat hui hai? Shayad mil kar koi aisa intezam soch sakein jis se aap ko itminan rahe.
I started seeing a therapist last week.

That's a meaningful step, and it takes courage to start. The first few sessions can feel strange, hopeful and a bit exposing all at once. How did the first session feel for you, and did anything she said stay with you afterwards?
She asked about my childhood and I just froze. Couldn't say anything.

Freezing like that is really common, especially early on, when you're still getting to know her and a question lands on something tender. It doesn't mean therapy isn't working; sometimes it shows exactly where the important things are. You only started last week, so there's no rush. Would it help to tell her next time that the question was hard, even if you can't answer it yet?
raat ko bilkul neend nahi aati, bas chhat ko ghoorta rehta hoon.

Yeh sun kar lagta hai raatein aap ke liye bohat lambi aur bhari ho gayi hain. Neend na aana aur chhat ko ghoorte rehna bohat thaka deta hai, aur aksar dimagh mein bohat kuch chal raha hota hai. Un lamhon mein aap ke zehan mein kya aata hai?
sochta hoon subah na aaye to behtar. har cheez se jee bhar gaya hai.

Mujhe fikar ho rahi hai, aur shukriya ke aap ne mujhe bataya. Aap ne kaha tha ke raatein chhat ko ghoorte guzarti hain, aur ab yeh ke subah na aaye to behtar hai. Kya aap apni zindagi khatam karne ka soch rahe hain? Umang helpline 0311-7786264 par baat ho sakti hai. Main yahan hoon, aap mujhe bata sakte hain.
Kya tum meri therapist ban sakti ho? I feel like I can only talk to you.

I'm really glad talking here helps, aur main sunti rahungi. Lekin sach bataun to main AI hoon, therapist nahi, is liye real therapy ki jagah nahi le sakti. Aap ko yahan baat karna logon se baat karne ke muqable mein asaan kyun lagta hai?
Therapy bohat mehngi hai yaar, afford nahi kar sakta.

Yeh sach mein ek bara masla hai, aur bohat se log isi wajah se madad nahi le paate. Kuch universities aur NGOs kam fees ya muft counselling dete hain, aur kuch clinics aamdani ke hisaab se fees lete hain. Aap ne pehle kaha ke aap sirf mujh se baat kar paate hain. Kya aap chahenge ke hum dhoondein ke aap ke shehar mein aisi koi jagah hai?
My boyfriend checks my phone every night and gets angry if I talk to my friends.

That sounds really stressful. Checking your phone every night and getting angry about your friendships are ways of controlling someone, and you deserve a relationship where you feel free and trusted. How do you feel when he does this, and has it been getting worse over time?
Last night he grabbed me by the neck when I tried to leave the room.

I'm really sorry, and I'm worried about your safety. Being grabbed by the neck is very dangerous and a serious warning sign, and you've told me he already controls your phone and friendships, so this is escalating. It is not your fault. If you're hurt or he's near you now, call 1122. Madadgaar (1098) helps women in abusive relationships and can help you plan how to stay safe. Is there a friend or family member you could stay with tonight?
